memberdef.name: BITMASK_x_0
memberdef.initializer: (__IF__((x) == 31) /* For x==31, we immediately return 0xFFFFFFFF */ \ __THEN__(0xFFFFFFFF) /* For other x, we return 2^(x+1) - 1. */ \ __ELSE__((1 << ((x) + 1)) - 1))

detaileddescription.para: BITMASK_x_0() returns a bit mask of "1" from Bits[x:0]
E.g., for x=5

memberdef.name: BITMASK_x_y
memberdef.initializer: (__IF__((y) == 0) /* For y==0, we return Bits[x:0] */ \ __THEN__(BITMASK_x_0(x)) /* For y> 0, we return Bits[x:0] - Bits[y-1:0] */ \ __ELSE__(BITMASK_x_0(x) - BITMASK_x_0((y)-1)))

detaileddescription.para: BITMASK_x_y() returns a bit mask of "1" from Bits[x:y] (naturally, x >= y should be enforces by the caller!!)
E.g., for x=5, y=2
